recipes.oracle_text: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. You lose life equal to that card's mana value.

recipe_coverage: Oracle-reviewed single-card recovery: eligible alternatives and full-zone indices, type/color/value restrictions, graveyard ownership, exact/insufficient mana, empty zone, ordered unaffected zones, target departure and index shift through a real Reclaim response, populated-zone snapshot replay. Reanimation also checks entry characteristics and subsequent death ownership; subtype bonuses are explicit. Multi-target recovery, graveyard shroud, replacement effects, and exceptional card types remain separate.
